subject.title: Feature request: api.callGatewayMethod() for inter-plugin communication

question: Should OpenClaw expose plugin-to-plugin Gateway RPC calls, and if so should the permanent SDK surface be raw method dispatch, an allowlisted request API, or typed capability/service accessors?
rationale: The requested API changes the public Plugin SDK and determines what Gateway methods plugin code may invoke, so automation cannot choose the authorization and compatibility contract safely.

options.title: Design a narrow authorized SDK contract
options.body: Expose only approved plugin-callable methods or typed capabilities with caller attribution, method policy, docs, and contract tests.

options.title: Keep only the HTTP-route dispatcher
options.body: Decline ordinary plugin-to-plugin Gateway calls and document the current authenticated-route helper as the supported boundary.

options.title: Expose raw Gateway dispatch
options.body: Add a generic method-string caller and explicitly accept the larger security and compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow authorized SDK contract
recommendation.body: Expose only approved plugin-callable methods or typed capabilities with caller attribution, method policy, docs, and contract tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the existing route-scoped Gateway dispatch contract and has the strongest history signal for the Gateway/Plugin SDK boundary.
